prevention: Any future supervisor/capsule binding must verify the operational checkpoint path and Git blob at the same repository snapshot before launch.
Checkpoint publication and pointer publication should be atomic/CAS or followed by a mandatory readback invariant.
A stale operational hash is fail-closed for launch but must not invalidate independent scientific state.

bind an explicitly authorized execution capsule to exact supervisor/spec/budget hashes
use a new exclusive v3 work root
do not reuse V255 operational overlay as current scientific authority
